basic_info.description: Great Investment Opportunity. Mid-Sunset Duplex has 2 beautiful identical flats. Each flat has 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths. The kitchens and bathrooms are updated nicely. Great rents. There is a 2 car s/s garage and a small backyard. Close to the Golden Gate Park, N-Judah, shopping and restaurants. Easy access to Peninsula and Marin freeways.
